name: gabriel-operator
description: Gabriel Operator skills for creating AI Personas from a Gabi token, plus workflows, Page Builder apps, team agents, pipelines, lists, todos, applications, asset libraries, embeds, and digital twin pages.

interface.longDescription:
Sign up at https://gabrieloperator.com/signup. Open Workspace, go to Dashboard, and copy your Gabi token (the key that starts with gabi_). Connect that token in ChatGPT before you run this plugin. Do not paste the raw token into chat.

This plugin interviews you and helps you build your dream AI persona faster. Extra skills are included so you can keep editing it afterward.
defaultPrompt: I signed up on Gabriel Operator and connected my Gabi token. Create a persona from this description.
Build a Gabriel workflow from this task.
Create a Page Builder app config.
